subtitle: Yajna Sri Śātakarṇi and the final flare of Satavahana power

panels.action: Yajna Sri Śātakarṇi stands on a Deccan escarpment in regal armor and cloth, wind tugging at his mantle as hills, rivers, and distant trade routes stretch away beneath a hazy sky.

dialogue.text: In the fading light of Satavahana power, Yajna Sri Śātakarṇi rises as the last great standard bearer of a vast Deccan realm.

i18n.hi: ढलती सातवाहन रोशनी में यज्ञ श्री शातकर्णि दक्कन साम्राज्य के आख़िरी महान ध्वजवाहक बनकर उठते हैं।

panels.action: A broad view of the Deccan plateau, with rocky hills, winding rivers, scattered towns, and distant Western Ghats fading into the evening, hinting at routes toward the Arabian Sea.

dialogue.text: For generations the Satavahanas ruled the Deccan, binding plateau and coast, craftsman and caravan, monk and cultivator in a long, shifting web of power.

i18n.hi: पीढ़ियों तक सातवाहनाओं ने दक्कन पर राज किया, पठार को तट से, कारीगर को कारवां से, भिक्षु को किसान से जोड़ते हुए।

panels.shot: slow push-in on a weathered stone inscription
panels.action: Close view of an ancient stone wall at Kanheri, with carefully carved Prakrit letters running in neat lines, lit by a shaft of soft cave light.

dialogue.text: When chronicles fall silent, stone remembers. At Kanheri and Nasik, chiseled letters speak of Yajna Sri Śātakarṇi’s name and reach.

i18n.hi: जब किताबें चुप हो जाती हैं, पत्थर बोलते हैं। कान्हेरी और नासिक की लिखावटों में यज्ञ श्री शातकर्णि का नाम और असर दर्ज है।

panels.shot: medium shot at court, slight low angle
panels.action: Yajna Sri Śātakarṇi sits on a modest but dignified throne in a Deccan hall, courtiers flanking him, maps and palm-leaf records laid out before the throne.

dialogue.text: He does not rise in a vacuum. Earlier Satavahana kings had strained against western Satraps, clashing and yielding ground long before his own time.

i18n.hi: वो अकेले नहीं उठते। पहले सातवाहन राजाओं ने पश्चिमी क्षत्रपों से टक्कर ली, उसके ज़माने से बहुत पहले ज़मीन जीती-हारी।

panels.shot: split composition showing Deccan plateau on one side and western coastal line on the other
panels.action: On the left, rugged inland forts crown hills; on the right, bustling coastal settlements with anchored ships and warehouses face the sea.

dialogue.text: By Yajna Sri’s age, Satavahana strength had stretched and thinned. Western tracts near the coast saw Satrap pressure, local chiefs sensed opportunity, and unity frayed.

i18n.hi: यज्ञ श्री के समय तक सातवाहन ताकत खिंचकर पतली हो चुकी थी। तटीय पश्चिम में क्षत्रपों का दबाव था, स्थानीय सरदार मौक़े की तलाश में थे, एकता टूट रही थी।

panels.shot: tight three-quarter profile on Yajna Sri, contemplative
panels.action: Yajna Sri Śātakarṇi studies a rough map showing the Deccan and western passes, his brow furrowed, hand resting on the hilt of his sword, light falling on his thoughtful face.

dialogue.speaker: yajna_sri_satakarni
dialogue.text: The west cannot be abandoned. Our standards must be seen there once more.

i18n.hi: पश्चिम छोड़ा नहीं जा सकता। हमारे ध्वज वहाँ फिर लहरने ही होंगे।

panels.shot: epic wide shot of marching columns
panels.action: Yajna Sri rides at the head of a Satavahana host across dusty plains, elephants and cavalry behind him, banners bearing the royal emblems streaming in the wind.

dialogue.text: He rallies what strength remains, pushing westward along ancient routes, reasserting Satavahana presence where rival flags had begun to flicker.

i18n.hi: वो बची-खुची शक्ति समेटकर, पुराने रास्तों से पश्चिम की ओर बढ़ता है, जहाँ पराए झंडे झिलमिलाने लगे थे, वहाँ सातवाहन मौजूदगी फिर दिखाता है।

panels.shot: medium shot in front of a cave façade
panels.action: Yajna Sri stands before the façade of a rock-cut cave at Nasik, flanked by monks and officials; the unfinished stone surfaces overlook the river valley below.

dialogue.text: At Nasik, his name is carved into grants for caves and monasteries, a sign that Satavahana authority has once more brushed these western valleys.

i18n.hi: नासिक में उसकी लिखी गुफ़ा और विहार दान-पट्टिकाएँ बताती हैं कि सातवाहन सत्ता एक बार फिर इन पश्चिमी घाटियों को छू गई है।

panels.shot: close-up on hands holding a copper plate or stone grant
panels.action: An official pair of hands presents a copper plate or stone record to ascetic monks; the etched text, though not legible, is clearly formal and carefully inscribed.

dialogue.text: These donations do more than express piety. They declare, to merchants and monks alike, whose protection shields the caves and roads.

i18n.hi: ये दान सिर्फ़ धर्म नहीं दिखाते। ये व्यापारी और भिक्षु सबको बता देते हैं कि गुफ़ाओं और सड़कों पर किसकी रखवाली है।

panels.action: Yajna Sri is seen in imagination, superimposed before Kanheri’s cliff, with rows of caves and steps; in the foreground, monks and traders move along the path.

dialogue.text: Far from his inland base, Kanheri’s inscriptions speak of his shadow on the coastal hills near the western sea lanes.

i18n.hi: अपने भीतरी अड्डे से दूर, कान्हेरी की अभिलिखाएँ उसके साए को पश्चिमी समुद्री राहों के पास तटीय पहाड़ियों पर दिखाती हैं।

panels.shot: close shot of Satavahana coin resting on cloth
panels.action: A Satavahana coin lies on a trader’s palm, its ship motif visible, set against folded textiles and beads that suggest commerce and port exchange.

dialogue.text: On coins linked to his age, ships sail in miniature relief. They hint at rulers who understand the lifeblood of coasts and long sea routes.

i18n.hi: उसके समय के सिक्कों पर उभरी लघु नौकाएँ चलती दिखती हैं। वो बताते हैं कि शासक तटों और लम्बी समुद्री राहों की नस-नस समझते हैं।

panels.shot: wide shot of a busy port scene
panels.action: Harbor quays bustle with workers loading bales onto large wooden vessels, while inland caravans arrive, joining the hum of an Indian Ocean port.

dialogue.text: Satavahana power does not float on fleets alone, but it leans on ports, on the taxes of goods, and on the safe passage of those who travel by river and sea.

i18n.hi: सातवाहन शक्ति सिर्फ़ बेड़ों पर नहीं टिकी, पर बन्दरगाहों, माल के करों और नदी-समुद्र से चलने वालों की सलामत राहों पर टिकी है।

panels.shot: somber interior shot in a royal audience hall
panels.action: Inside a dim hall, regional chieftains stand a little apart from the central throne space, each with distinct retainers, their expressions proud and cautious.

dialogue.text: Yet even as Yajna Sri extends his reach, centrifugal forces grow. Local elites weigh their loyalties, imagining futures with their own emblems raised high.

i18n.hi: पर जैसे-जैसे यज्ञ श्री हाथ फैलाते हैं, बिखराव की ताकतें भी बढ़ती हैं। स्थानीय कुलीन अपनी निष्ठा तौलते हैं, अपने-अपने चिन्ह ऊँचे उठे भविष्य सोचते हैं।

panels.shot: close-up on Yajna Sri’s face in half-shadow
panels.action: Yajna Sri sits slightly turned from the viewer, one side of his face lit, the other in shadow, eyes distant, as the murmur of court fades around him.

dialogue.speaker: yajna_sri_satakarni
dialogue.text: A king can reclaim ground, not youth for an old house.

i18n.hi: राजा ज़मीन तो लौटा सकता है, किसी बूढ़े घर की जवान उम्र नहीं।

panels.shot: montage-style wide shot with ghosted banners of different dynasties rising
panels.action: Over a fading Satavahana banner, new standards of Abhira, Ikshvaku, and Chutu realms rise in different directions across the Deccan landscape.

dialogue.text: After his time, the once-broad realm fragments. Abhira chiefs, Ikshvaku rulers, Chutu lords and others claim pieces of the Deccan, forging successor states.

i18n.hi: उसके बाद कभी चौड़ा रहा राज्य टूटने लगता है। अभिरा सरदार, इक्ष्वाकु शासक, चुटु नरेश और दूसरे दक्कन के टुकड़े बाँटकर नए राज्य बनाते हैं।

panels.shot: wide shot of Nagarjunakonda valley and river
panels.action: A serene view of Nagarjunakonda’s river valley, with early Buddhist structures and foundations dotting the landscape, hills enclosing a quiet, misty basin.

dialogue.text: In places like Nagarjunakonda, new powers build and patronize, while memories of Satavahana kings linger in stone, coin, and the alignment of routes they once guarded.

i18n.hi: नागार्जुनकोंड जैसे स्थानों पर नए बलशाली राजे बनवाते और सरंक्षण देते हैं, जबकि सातवाहन राजाओं की याद पत्थर, सिक्के और उन रास्तों की दिशा में बची रहती है जिनकी वो पहरेदारी करते थे।

panels.shot: slow pan across cave interiors with multiple inscription panels
panels.action: Inside rock-cut caves, the camera glides past different inscription panels, some bearing the name of Yajna Sri, others of later donors, showing layers of writing through time.

dialogue.text: Historians read these scattered records, tracing how his grants mark a late peak, and how later lines chart the shift to new dynasties and patrons.

i18n.hi: इतिहासकार इन्हीं बिखरे सुराग़ों को पढ़ते हैं, देखते हैं कैसे उसके दान आख़िरी उछाल दिखाते हैं और बाद की लिखावटें नई वंशों और नए संरक्षकों की तरफ़ मोड़ दर्ज करती हैं।

panels.shot: heroic but wistful medium shot on Yajna Sri against an evening sky
panels.action: Yajna Sri stands alone on a fort wall at dusk, standard beside him drooping slightly, as the sky glows orange and the land below sinks into shadow.

dialogue.text: He is remembered not as the founder, nor as the conqueror of all, but as the last great Satavahana who gathered what remained and made it blaze once more.

i18n.hi: उसे न संस्थापक के रूप में याद किया जाता है, न सबका विजेता, बल्कि उस आख़िरी महान सातवाहन की तरह जिसने जो बचा था उसे समेटकर फिर एक बार भड़का दिया।

panels.shot: final pull-back from Deccan landscape into starry night
panels.action: The Deccan fades into a star-filled sky, faint outlines of old trade routes and river paths glowing like constellations connecting hills, caves, and coasts.

dialogue.text: His story teaches that even as an order dissolves, a last rally can steady roads, honor old bonds, and leave marks in stone and memory that endure beyond a dynasty’s fall.

i18n.hi: उसकी कथा बताती है कि व्यवस्था बिखरती रहे, तब भी आख़िरी जुटान रास्तों को सँभाल सकती है, पुराने रिश्ते निभा सकती है, और पत्थर व यादों में ऐसे निशान छोड़ सकती है जो किसी वंश के ढहने के बाद भी टिके रहते हैं।

subtitle_i18n.en: Yajna Sri Śātakarṇi and the final flare of Satavahana power
subtitle_i18n.hi: यज्ञ श्री शातकर्णि और सातवाहन शक्ति की अंतिम चमक
